requirements.text: 7+ years building and operating web applications in production, end-to-end.
React on the frontend (Next.js or comparable).
Backend depth: API design, relational data modelling (PostgreSQL), third-party integrations.
A track record of owning features from idea to production with real users.
Product mindset: talks to users, challenges requirements and cuts scope to ship.
AI deeply integrated into your daily engineering work, beyond autocompletion.
Experience with containerised deployments (e.g. Docker) and CI/CD.
A degree in computer science or a related field, or an equivalent track record.
A valid work permit for Germany and readiness to work on-site in Munich.
LLM-based features in production (RAG, agents, evaluations).
Experience in a start-up or scale-up.
Exposure to fintech, accounting, tax or payroll.

resumes.text:
Jonas Krüger
Senior Software Engineer | Munich, Germany
German residence permit valid until 2031. Ready to work on-site in Munich.

Summary
Software engineer with nine years of building and running web applications in production. I own features from first sketch to live use, and I like working close to users and founders to decide what to build and what to cut.

Experience

- Built the core services in TypeScript on Node.js and the customer dashboard in Next.js with React.
- Designed the tables and relationships for a double-entry ledger with strict constraints, and connected three external accounting and payment services through their web endpoints.
- Built an internal support assistant that finds answers in our internal wiki and checks each draft against the source documents before staff see it.
- Shipped every service in Docker containers with a CI/CD pipeline that runs tests and deploys on merge.
- Led code reviews and mentored two junior engineers.
- Use GitHub Copilot for code suggestions during daily work.

Software Engineer, Brightline Commerce, Hamburg (2016 - 2021)
- Developed a Node.js API layer for a marketplace platform.
- Built React front ends for seller tools as part of a team of eight at a scale-up that grew from 20 to 150 people.
- Contributed to PostgreSQL schema design and query tuning.

Software Engineer, Versicherung Nord AG, Kiel (2014 - 2016)
- Maintained back-office systems for insurance claims processing.

Education
M.Sc. Computer Science, Kiel University (2014)

TypeScript, Node.js, React, Next.js, PostgreSQL, Docker, CI/CD, Git, English C1, German native.
